The operation of adding $2\ell$ twists to the first band modifies the linking form (or the intersection form associated with the Seifert surface).
In the context of genus-one knots (torus knots or satellite knots with genus 1), a band sum or twist operation affects the entries of the Seifert matrix. If $K(\ell, 0)$ is obtained by adding twists, its Alexander polynomial will likely differ by a factor of $(t-1)^{2\ell}$ or similar, unless specific conditions are met.

So $\Delta_K(t) = a_{12} a_{21} t^2 + (-2 a_{11} a_{22} - a_{12}^2 + a_{21}^2) t + a_{11} a_{22} + a_{12} a_{21}$.
